id: AT-RN-09 (the runner files tools/check executes are executable)
note: tools/check's X-H executes tests/helper/run.pl itself (subprocess, no perl in front) and the launcher cases run tests/launcher/run.sh; a commit once dropped run.pl's executable bit (100755 to 100644), which ends X-H with a PermissionError instead of a failing case. A child run that executes run.pl directly passes its one case, and run.pl and tests/launcher/run.sh are executable files and, in a git work tree, 100755 in the index. The watch driver (run-watch.pl) is run through perl and stays 100644

steps.name: a child run that executes run.pl itself, as X-H does
run.pl and the launcher cases' run.sh are executable, also in git's index
